name: MonarchEntityPicker
title: EntityPicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and an androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchAvatar rows with androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton or Checkbox marks; MonarchFormField around a clickable field
summary: A field for picking one or several people or records from a list that the app can search on its server, shown with avatars, in a bottom sheet.
whenToUse: For an owner, an assignee, reviewers, a company or a project: entities with a name, a picture and often too many to list without search.
whenNotToUse: For plain options without pictures use MonarchCombobox or MonarchMultiSelect. For a short fixed list use MonarchSelect. For mentions inside text use MonarchMentionPicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchEntityPicker(label: String, entities: List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity>, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, selectedEntities: List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, minSearchLength: Int = 0, debounceMillis: Long = 250L, search: (suspend (String) -> List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity>)? = null, onCreate: (suspend (String) -> MonarchEntityPickerEntity?)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchEntityPickerLabels = MonarchEntityPickerLabels())

@Composable fun MonarchEntityPicker(label: String, entities: List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity>, selected: List<String>, onSelectedChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, selectedEntities: List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, minSearchLength: Int = 0, debounceMillis: Long = 250L, search: (suspend (String) -> List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity>)? = null, onCreate: (suspend (String) -> MonarchEntityPickerEntity?)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchEntityPickerLabels = MonarchEntityPickerLabels())

class MonarchEntityPickerEntity(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, hint: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Circle, keywords: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchEntityPickerLabels(select: String? = null, search: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, done: String? = null, loading: String? = null, empty: String? = null, tooShort: ((minLength: Int) -> String)? = null, failed: String? = null, retry: String? = null, create: ((text: String) -> String)? = null, summary: ((first: String, others: Int) -> String)? = null, clear: String? = null, none: String? = null)

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: entities
options.description: The entities to pick from: id, name, description, hint, image (a Painter the app loads), shape, keywords and enabled. With search, shown until the first search runs.

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen id, or the chosen ids in pick order. The list form lets several be picked and keeps the sheet open until Done.

options.name: selectedEntities
options.description: Entities for chosen ids that may not be in entities, so the field can show their names and pictures. Entities chosen from search results or created are also remembered while the field is shown.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false the field does nothing and takes the disabled colors.

options.name: required
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the field's name.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows "Loading…" in the list while entities is empty.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen. "Select…" when null.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message, shown under the field with the form field's error style, set on the field and announced.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Single choice only. Adds a first row that clears the selection, such as "Unassigned". Hidden while searching.

options.name: minSearchLength
options.description: The shortest trimmed text search runs for. Shorter text shows "Type at least N characters to search."

options.name: debounceMillis
options.description: How long to wait after typing before search runs. A newer text cancels the wait and the older search.

options.name: search
options.description: Loads the entities matching the trimmed text. Throw to show "The results could not be loaded." with Try again. Without it, entities are filtered by name, hint and keywords.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no shown name equals the typed text. The returned entity is chosen; null chooses nothing.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field, shown while something is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

states.name: empty
states.description: The field shows the prompt in the subtle text color.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the first chosen entity's avatar and name, or "First +N" for several, and the clear button when there is a clearIcon.

states.name: searching
states.description: The list shows "Loading…" and the search field its pending state while the debounce waits or the search runs.

states.name: too short
states.description: The list asks for more characters and does not search.

states.name: failed
states.description: The list shows MonarchInlineErrorRetry with the message and Try again, which runs the same text again.

states.name: no match
states.description: The list shows "No matches", or the Create row when there is onCreate.

states.name: error
states.description: The field's border takes the danger color and the message shows under it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the muted fill and the disabled text color and does not open. A disabled entity's row is dimmed and cannot be chosen.

appearance: The field is a surface with the input border role (danger border with an error, subtle border and muted fill when disabled); rows show a small MonarchAvatar, the name in the default text role and the description and hint in the muted text role, with radio or check marks in the accent solid role. The sheet uses the surface role. All come from MonarchTheme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover under a trigger; on Android the list opens in a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field, as in the system contact pickers, and the same on iOS. The web's custom trigger, renderOption, renderValue, footer and sm/md/lg sizes are not offered: rows are fixed avatar rows with 48dp targets, and a footer action belongs in the screen. Search is a suspend function cancelled through coroutine cancellation instead of an AbortSignal. Pictures are Painters the app loads, as everywhere in Monarch, instead of iOS's Image or URL; iOS's systemImage has no Android counterpart because Monarch bundles no icons, so an entity without a picture shows initials. Duration becomes debounceMillis. Same name as iOS.
accessibility: The field is one button named by the field's label (with "Required" when required); its state description is every chosen name joined with commas, or "None".
The error is set on the field and announced through the form field's polite live region.
Avatars are decorative because the name is written beside them.
The clear button is a separate button named "Clear" with a 48dp target.

Each row is one element read with its name, description and hint: a radio button with the selected state for one choice, a checkbox with its checked state for several. Disabled entities are read as disabled.
Loading, too short and no match messages are polite live regions; a failed search offers a Try again button.
The field and every row are at least 48dp high.
edgeCases: A chosen id that is in neither entities nor selectedEntities, and was not picked while the field was shown, is not displayed; pass it in selectedEntities.
With search, the entities are shown while the text is empty and until the first search answers.
An exact name match hides the Create row, ignoring case and accents.
Creating an entity that is already chosen in the multiple form does not remove it.
Long names wrap in the rows; the field shows the first name with "+N".

    label = {{label}},
    entities = projects,
    selected = project,
    onSelectedChange = { project = it },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    clearOptionLabel = {{clearOption}},
    footerLabel = {{footer}},
    onFooter = {},
    initiallyOpen = true,
)
